name: Punyashlok Ahilyadevi Holkar Karjmafi Yojana
benefit_summary: Waiver of up to ₹2 lakh on overdue short-term crop loans (cutoff: overdue as of 30 September 2025), plus a ₹50,000 incentive for farmers who repaid their loans on time
required_documents: Bank loan account details (nationalised bank, district cooperative bank, or Regional Rural Bank)
Loan sanction and outstanding balance statement
notes: VERIFY against your own karjmafi_maharashtra.txt — announced in the Maharashtra 2026 state budget; the official application portal and exact disbursal process were still being notified at time of writing. Confirm current status before advising farmers.
